# Kova

> A lightweight desktop utility for system monitoring, clipboard history, workspace profiles, and disk cleanup. Built with Tauri and Rust, runs from the tray on Windows and macOS.

Kova is a fast, privacy-first desktop app that lives in your system tray. It combines system monitoring (CPU, memory, disk, network), clipboard history with search, workspace profiles for switching contexts, disk cleanup, and a quick launcher, all in one lightweight tool.

## Key Features

- **System Monitor**: Real-time CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics from the tray
- **Clipboard History**: Searchable clipboard with pinning and favorites
- **Workspace Profiles**: Switch between project contexts instantly
- **Disk Cleanup**: Find and remove junk files to free up space
- **Quick Launcher**: Open apps, files, and URLs with a keyboard shortcut
- **Tray-native**: Runs quietly in the system tray, no dock clutter

## Pricing

- Free tier with core features
- Pro at $2.99/month for advanced features

## Platforms

- Windows 10/11
- macOS
